backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Anant Aasha Foundation backend, defining data stores and types for schools, students, classes, attendance, OCR extractions, visual notebooks, and academic performance, with mixins for blob storage and authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the implementation of a semi-transparent disclaimer overlay caption on all frontend images, listing the affected files and associated components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key details of each component, page, hook, and style file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark modes, including color variables for backgrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, setting the page title to 'Anant Aasha Foundation Safe Digital & Eco Seva Ecosystem' and mounting the app at the root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that manages client-side page routing via a Page union type, wraps the app in React Query, and conditionally renders a profile setup modal for authenticated users without a profile.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying the NGO logo, social media links, quick navigation links (including Legal Info), contact details, and a caffeine.ai attribution with dynamic year.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky navigation header component that handles Internet Identity login/logout, role-based navigation buttons (teacher dashboard, student notebook/game), and a mobile slide-out menu.
frontend/src/components/ImageWithDisclai: Wrapper component that renders an image with an overlaid disclaimer text strip at the bottom, noting that the image depicts an aspirational vision rather than reality.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog shown to newly authenticated users to collect their name and role (student, teacher, or donor) and save it as a user profile via mutation.
frontend/src/components/StudentRegistrat: Form component for teachers/admins to register a student by entering their details, validating a school name (creating one if absent), and submitting to the backend via a mutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook that manage AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout flow, identity persistence, and expose login status to the component tree.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for all backend interactions including user profiles, OCR extractions, questions, visual notebook chapters, schools, and student registration.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes using oklch colors, plus utility classes for 3D card flip transforms.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AashaCoinsPage.tsx: Marketing/informational page explaining the Aasha Points rewards system, showing how children earn points through learning and redeem them for educational supplies like notebooks and science kits.
frontend/src/pages/AashaStorePage.tsx: Authenticated store page where users can browse and purchase items (certificates, badges, physical rewards) using their Aasha Coin balance, with a purchase confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Informational page about the Anant Aasha Foundation NGO, covering its origin story, mission, and official registration details.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Empty file with no content — admin panel page not yet implemented.
frontend/src/pages/AuctionPage.tsx: Authenticated auction page displaying active coin-based item auctions and a leaderboard, allowing users to place bids via a dialog with coin balance validation.
frontend/src/pages/DonateGoodsPage.tsx: Page for donating physical goods (books, clothes, electronics, etc.) to children in need, featuring a category selector and a donation submission form.
frontend/src/pages/DonateMoneyPage.tsx: A page for monetary donations to Anant Aasha Foundation, displaying a hero section with tax exemption info, a 'coming soon' online payment notice with contact details, and a grid showing three funding categories (Education, Environment, Community) with images.
frontend/src/pages/EcoSevaPage.tsx: A tabbed page presenting the foundation's environmental programs: 'Eco-Seva' (tree adoption with geo-tagging) and 'Jal-Seva' (water conservation), each with descriptive content and imagery.
frontend/src/pages/EmpowermentPage.tsx: A page showcasing the foundation's holistic child empowerment approach through four pillars—Education, Environment, Community, and Skills—each displayed as an image card with a description.
frontend/src/pages/GuardianGamePage.tsx: An interactive educational quiz game where players battle subject-themed bosses (Math, Science, History) by answering multiple-choice questions, with health tracking, combo scoring, and win/loss states.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: The main landing page for Anant Aasha Foundation, featuring a hero section with logo and CTAs, and a grid of program cards (Eco-Seva, empowerment, etc.) with hover effects linking to other pages.
frontend/src/pages/ImpactDashboard.tsx: Displays a read-only impact dashboard with static mock data showing overall stats, environmental impact metrics, recent activities, and per-school statistics using tabs and cards. Includes a notice that real-time backend data is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/pages/LearningDashboard.tsx: Renders a student learning dashboard showing subject progress bars, Aasha Points, day streak, and quick-action navigation buttons. Uses static mock data for five subjects with clickable progress cards.
frontend/src/pages/LegalInfoPage.tsx: Displays Anant Aasha Foundation's legal and compliance information including 12A registration and 80G provisional approval details in a structured, styled layout. All data is static and hardcoded.
frontend/src/pages/SafeLearningPage.tsx: Marketing/informational page for the Safe Learning program describing digital tools, gamified learning, and Aasha Points with navigation buttons to the learning dashboard and visual notebook. Content is static with an illustrative hero image.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherDashboard.tsx: Teacher-only dashboard (guarded by authentication and role checks) showing static lesson stats and a list of recent lessons, plus an upload dialog that currently shows a backend-pending notice. Uses Internet Identity for auth and a user profile role check.
Teacher/admin dashboard page that handles PDF upload with simulated OCR extraction, visual notebook chapter submission, and student registration, with role-based access control restricting non-teachers/admins.
frontend/src/pages/VisualNotebookPage.ts: Visual notebook page displaying subject selection and interactive learning materials (flashcards, slides) with sample Hinglish content for students, using static mock data.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read, persist, and clear URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback for persistence across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a custom design system with OKLCH color tokens, border radius variables, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (version 13) documenting the NGO-focused LMS platform architecture, including multi-tenant school/class isolation, role-based dashboards, school auto-create/resolve logic, and known build issues.
